sentences.text: Shri Vikas Jyotshi - Advocate for the applicants.

Shri Himanshu Tiwari- Panel Lawyer for respondent/ Sta
Appeal is already admitted for hearing.
Heard on I.A.Nos.14108/2023, an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of appellant No.2 Kalyandas Rathor.

Appellant along with co-appellants have been convicted for commission of offence under Section 420 read with Section 120-B, 467 read with Section 120B, 468 read with Section 120B and 471 red with Section 120B of IPC.

They have been sentenced to 5-5 years RI and 2 years RI and fine of Rs.2000-2000/- and Rs.1000/- each with default stipulation vide judgement dated 06.12.2022,
passed in S.T.No.192/2013 (State of M.P. Vs. Shehzad Ali and Others) by 1st, ASJ, Anuppur, District Anuppur.

entities.text: S.T.No.192/2013 (State of M.P. Vs. Shehzad Ali and Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that appellant has been erroneously convicted as learned trial Court has not properly appreciated evidence on record.
Learned counsel for the appellant has pointed out the omissions and contradictions appeared in the evidence of the witness and have submitted that appellant has fair chance to succeed in appeal.
He is in jail for almost last 6 months.
Co-accused has already been released on bail.
Therefore, it has been prayed that appellant be released on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
Appellant has already suffered more than six months incarceration.
In course of trial he was on bail and he never misused the liberty granted to him by way of bail.
As per listing policy, there is no possibility of hearing of this appeal in near future.

Therefore having taken into consideration the submission of learned counsel for the parties and evidence on record, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.

sentences.text: Consequently, I.A.No.14108/2023 i s allowed.
The execution of jail sentence of appellant No.2 - Kalyandas Rathor is hereby suspended subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited.

It is directed that the appellant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond to a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the trial Court on 22.8.2023 and also on such other dates, as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List these cases for final hearing in due course along with connected appeals.
Certified copy as per rules.
